text:
```yaml
name: Test Analysis

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Tests"]
    types:
      - completed

jobs:
  publish-test-results:
    if: github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' && github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests && github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Download JUnit XML artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: junit
          path: junit

      - name: Publish test results
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-test-results@v2
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          test_results: junit/**/*.xml
```
